description: Get one exam's details: current status and date, its ParikshaIndex section pages (result, admit card, answer key…), curated facts with their official sources (vacancies, age, fee, qualification, pay, dates) and its newest official documents with PDF links. Use it after search_exams, with the `slug` of the exam result. Read-only, no side effects. Limitations: facts are present only for exams ParikshaIndex has checked (`facts` is then omitted); dates are as the commission published them and may change, so users should confirm on the official website.
name: get_exam
title: Get exam details
